QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Winning the Debut Spot
QuestInfo.0: After many twists and turns, Jackpot Entertainment has finally found itself with not one, but five singers! All that remains to prepare for the debut. But who will take over Dia Mandy's duties as secretary? Talk to #bBlake#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Only one new team will allowed on Kerning City Superstars! Come in #b1st in the preliminary text vote#k to earn the debut broadcast spot!

#r* If you fail to reach 1st, you must forfeit the quest and try again.
QuestInfo.2: Jackpot Entertainment's new group won the preliminary text vote by a landslide, securing their spot on Kerning City Superstars! The future looks bright for Jackpot Entertainment!

0.0: It's settled. Our group will consist of five members: Ruthie Bea, Savanna Faia, Peri Dotts, Amy Thys, and Dia Mandy.
0.1: If we want to make a big impact with our debut, there's only one way to do it. Kerning City Superstars broadcasts straight from this tower, and we're going to win it!
0.2: As you likely know, the only way to get on the show is for audience members to text in a vote for our group.
0.3: The good news is, I already signed you girls up, and I posted fliers all around Kerning Tower. The bad news is, the broadcast is about to start!
0.4: Hurry, text in your #bvote#k for Jackpot Entertainment's new group, everybody! The number is on the screen!

yes.0: #b#h0##k! What're you doing? You need to vote too! Here, use my old Yokia phone.

1.0: We did it!  Did you hear that? An overwhelming lead! We're going to be on Kerning City Superstars!

yes.0: For the first time in a long while, the future is looking bright for Jackpot Entertainment!

default.0: Only one new group per round gets to be on Kerning City Superstars. That's the one who comes in first place via text-in-vote!
